{{Quote|An unscheduled ship entered the atmosphere in sector S-11 and failed to register. The rebels may be operating in that area.|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]|<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>}}
'''Sector S11''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] that was suspected by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to contain a base of the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]]. Although their [[Onderon insurgent camp/Legends|real base]] was in [[Sector S-29/Legends|Sector S-29]], this was the location where [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] met with the incoming [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
